documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported financial and operational highlights for the 2025-26 fiscal year in its Annual Report, registering a 15.65% increase in operating income and strong profitability. Management detailed ongoing infrastructure expansions, such as the approved construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital, and highlighted advanced technology implementations including AI-powered radiation therapy and robotic-assisted surgeries. The company maintained a focus on clinical excellence, affordable healthcare access, and academic initiatives across its medical institutes. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for the fiscal year 2024-25, achieving a 12% growth in operating revenue to Rs. 1,37,111.30 lakhs and a profit margin of 15%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the hospital will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
guidance.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand continues to rise, driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted high demand for admissions resulting in all seats being filled at the medical college.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises, with work expected to commence during the second quarter of 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Management announced plans for a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai, with the OP block ready for operation by the year-end.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai. The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made an investment of Rs. 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its own Respiratory Medicine department institute introducing cutting-edge technology and minimally invasive procedures.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, the Respiratory Medicine department launched its own institute, introducing cutting-edge technology and minimally invasive procedures available at only a select few centers nationwide.

capex_expansion.claim: Management highlighted plans for an upcoming neurosciences center equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its solar power capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, the company has expanded its capacity by adding a further 5 MW solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in medical equipment during the financial year 2023-24 amounted to 5,239.02 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15% for the year 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a profit margin of 15% for the year 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the hospital has a capacity of 2000 beds.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March, 2025 was 5992 nos.
orders_capacity.quote: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March, 2025 was 5992 nos.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of fifteen rupees per share for the Financial Year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: Work on constructing a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the outpatient block of the Chennai hospital will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami was re-appointed as Managing Director for a period of five years with effect from October 1, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board in its meeting held on 25th May, 2024 had resolved to re-appoint Dr.Nalla G Palaniswami for a period of five years with effect from 01st October, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. V. Bhuvaneshwari was re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years effective September 3, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director of the Company to hold office for a second term of five consecutive years with effect from 3rd September, 2024

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vasanth Kumar Venkatasamy was appointed as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years starting September 1, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby appointed as an Independent Director of the Company, to hold office for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years, from 1st September, 2024 upto 31st August, 2029.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
